metadata.description: Function-hook mods that ship beside the agent-scripts skills.

plugins.name: grok-bot-watch
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: watches a Grok Bot bot by UUID over a read-only CDP sidebar read and wakes this session when a new reply lands. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: session-recall
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: a numbered list of what a session made (URLs, artifacts, files, images, commits). Write #aN in a prompt to hand Claude the exact ref and whether it is still up; Claude looks them up with its assets tool, even after compaction. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: agent-should-know
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: sends each card of the built-in You should know mod (cc-plugin-you-should-know), with its Learn more explanation, to the main agent as a prompt once the running turn ends, hides the card, and logs the card with the agent's verdict in one file per session under ~/.local/state/agent-should-know/. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
